statement: Linux hid-playstation's DS4 USB output report 0x05 places the common HID effects block after one report-ID byte, while BT output 0x11 inserts hardware-control and audio-control header bytes before common effects and a trailing CRC. Common validity bytes gate rumble/lightbar/blink; the audited Linux DS4 effects struct has no per-field speaker/headphone/microphone volume, mic mute or PCM payload. SDL PS4 separately defines four audio-volume slots in its effect block, so the two consumers' representations differ; the SDL volume names do not demonstrate Linux or device support.

applicability.scope: Zero-based offsets; kernel USB common starts full-report byte 1 and BT at byte 3, not the same layout as SDL.
